title: Administrator: Data
company: Norton Rose Fulbright LLP - Agency - Permanent
description:
Practice Group / Department:

IT Regional - Project & Program Management - London

Job Description

Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions with a full business law service.

With over 50 offices and 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us, as well as our values of unity, quality and integrity. Our strategy and culture are connected - defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we look for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do - ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.

Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.

The Role

The Finance Systems Team is responsible for supporting the core EMEA finance system (Aderant Sierra), including time, billing, expenses, vendors, tax and reporting. We are seeking a Data Administrator, with Aderant and Finance Operations experience, to join our EMEA team.

This is a key role in supporting the day-to-day function of the firm's EMEA finance systems and will provide essential assistance to finance operations and other data users, including senior stakeholders in the firm. This will include delivery of ongoing data monitoring and support for master data management, and data acquisition and preparation for a variety of business and operational stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
- User Support: support application users, and respond to queries and requests from fee earners, secretaries and finance operations staff for data changes, extracts and updates.
- Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: monitor the health and performance of data systems, identify and resolve quality issues, bottlenecks and anomalies, and identify, analyse and resolve and other data-related problems, and minimise errors.
- Work with third party support providers, IT and finance operations to resolve logged issues.
- Data Monitoring and Management: support the provision of advanced data management for financial systems, including applying data governance and stewardship standards, supporting enforcement of permission structures, maintaining data taxonomies, schemas and mapping, conducting regular data cleansing, de-duplication and remediation, and updating and changing data in line with changing business needs.
- Data Acquisition and Preparation: source, collect, clean and structure data for operational use and analysis, using SQL queries and logic if necessary.
- Continuous Improvement: understand user requirements and requests, identify opportunities for enhancements and work with teams to test and implement changes.
- Help to improve procedures and processes for all stakeholders.

Skills and Experience Required

We are seeking a proactive, and solutions-oriented individual with experience working with financial systems and finance operations.

You will need to be able to communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders at all levels across the business, including for a variety of data and business intelligence issues and stakeholder requests.

You'll also need the following skills and experience:
- Ideally degree educated and/or 3+ years of experience a similar role.
- Good customer/user service abilities, demonstrated by resolving user queries and working with customers.
- Data management experience and/or expertise in finance practice management systems (FPMS).
- SQL proficiency, as well as the ability to run queries unsupervised.
- Experience working within structured ITSM frameworks, such as ITIL.
- Familiarity with core finance processes (general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, budgeting, forecasting, reporting) ideal.
- Experience within a law firm or other professional services environment desired.
- Solutions-orientated and proactive approach to work.
- Willingness to upskill on the job through internal and external training.
- Able to demonstrate discretion, sensitivity and confidentiality.
- Team player - flexible and willing to take on extra responsibilities to support departmental or firm objectives.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

To attract the best people, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work, have a sense of belonging, and realize their full career potential.
Our new enabled work model allows our people to have more flexibility in the way they choose to work from both the office and a remote location, while continuing to deliver the highest standards of service. We offer a range of family friendly and inclusive employment policies and provide access to programmes and services aimed at nurturing our people's health and overall wellbeing. Find more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams. We strive to create an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any tailored adjustments or accommodations, please let us know here.

title: HR Administrator

HR Administrator (Part-Time, 6-Month FTC)

25 hours per week Newcastle

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Confidence handling confidential information
- A proactive, supportive approach and great communication skills
- Experience supporting recruitment processes or coordinating candidate activity

Why apply?

This is a brilliant opportunity to join a friendly, collaborative People Team where you'll gain exposure to a wide range of HR and recruitment activities. Perfect for someone seeking part-time hours while continuing to build their HR career.

title: HR Assistant
description:
The Opportunity:
Temporary HR Assistant
- Location: South Tyneside
- Salary: £28,500 per annum, depending on skills, qualifications and HR experience
- Contract: Temporary, 2 to 3 months
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 5.00pm, 37.5 hours per week
- Working arrangement: Primarily office-based, with some home working potentially required depending on business needs

Are you an experienced HR Assistant looking for your next temporary opportunity?

My client is seeking a confident and proactive HR Assistant to provide comprehensive support across employee relations, recruitment, onboarding and HR administration. Reporting to the HR Manager, this is a varied role where you will work closely with managers across the business, offering first-line guidance and helping to deliver a professional, consistent and legally compliant HR service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide first-line HR advice to managers on attendance, probation, performance, conduct and other day-to-day employee relations matters.
- Support disciplinary, grievance, absence management, flexible working and capability processes.
- Prepare letters, meeting packs, scripts and other HR documentation tailored to individual cases.
- Take accurate notes during formal meetings and guide managers through company procedures.
- Support organisational change, restructures, redundancy consultations and TUPE-related administration.
- Assist with recruitment activity, including job descriptions, adverts, candidate communication and recruitment administration.
- Complete pre-employment checks, including right-to-work and DBS checks.
- Coordinate new starter administration, onboarding, inductions and probation reviews.
- Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, spreadsheets and HR files.
- Produce HR correspondence, reports and management information.
- Support payroll administration and monitor employee lifecycle activities.
- Manage telephone and email enquiries professionally, including several busy inboxes.

About You:
We are looking for someone who can combine sound HR knowledge with excellent organisation, attention to detail and a willingness to support high-volume administrative activity.

You will ideally have:
- A minimum of three years' experience in an HR Assistant or HR Administration role, with this being your current or most recent position.
- Experience supporting employee relations matters, including absence, disciplinary, grievance and probation processes.
- Basic knowledge of UK employment law, including redundancy consultation and TUPE principles.
- Experience drafting HR correspondence, meeting invitations, outcome letters and manager scripts.
- Confidence advising and constructively challenging managers when appropriate.
- Experience using an HR information system, ideally People First or a similar platform.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong attention to detail and a process-driven approach.

Knowledge of HR best practice, further employee relations experience and a full UK driving licence would also be beneficial.
Why Apply?
This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy HR function and gain exposure to a broad range of employee relations, recruitment and HR operational activity. The role would suit an experienced HR Assistant who can quickly build relationships, confidently support managers and balance advisory work with essential HR administration.

If you are available at short notice and meet the essential requirements, please apply with an up-to-date CV for further information.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Independent Utility Advice Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
About Independent Utility Advice

Independent Utility Advice is a leading utility consultancy, helping businesses reduce costs and manage their energy requirements through expert advice, procurement and ongoing account management. We pride ourselves on delivering outstanding customer service, commercial insight and long-term value for our clients.

About the Role

We're looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to join our growing Finance team. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working with numbers, and are committed to maintaining accurate financial records and supporting business operations, this is the role for you.

This is an exciting opportunity to support the day-to-day financial activities of the business, ensuring financial information is processed accurately and efficiently. Working closely with the wider Finance team and stakeholders across the organisation, you will play an important role in maintaining robust financial controls and supporting the company's continued growth.

As a growing business, flexibility and teamwork are important to us. This job description outlines the main responsibilities of the role but is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be asked to support with other tasks that contribute to the success of the team and wider business.

Key Responsibilities
- Process purchase invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Assist with sales ledger activities, including raising invoices and allocating customer payments.
- Support credit control activities and follow up on outstanding customer balances.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies.
- Process employee expenses in line with company policies.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and daily cash allocation.
- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure documentation is filed appropriately.
- Support month-end and year-end finance processes.
- Assist with preparing financial reports and management information.
- Liaise with suppliers, customers, and internal departments regarding finance-related queries.
- Ensure all financial transactions are processed in accordance with company procedures and controls.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Finance function.
- Maintain confidentiality and handle financial information with professionalism and integrity.
- Assist the wider Finance team with ad hoc administrative and financial tasks as required.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant, or similar finance administration role.
- Experience processing invoices and reconciling financial transactions.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.

Desirable
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, or similar systems.
- AAT qualification or currently studying towards an accounting qualification.
- Experience supporting month-end processes.
- Understanding of financial controls and accounting principles.

Key Competencies
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Proactive and solution-focused approach.
- Strong numerical aptitude.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Reliable and trustworthy when handling confidential information.
- Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment.
- Committed to delivering high standards of work and continuous improvement.

Benefits
- Private healthcare
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Tech Scheme
- 50% discount on LNER train travel
- Hotel and restaurant discounts
- Team social events and incentives
- Early Friday finishes (performance-based)
- Paid day off on your birthday
- Structured onboarding and ongoing training

If you're looking for a Finance Assistant role where you can make a real impact, develop your career, and become part of a growing and ambitious business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Planner
description:
The opportunity
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-profile marketing function at a time of significant growth and transformation. You'll play a central role in shaping how marketing activity is planned, prioritised and delivered, working across multiple teams, channels and audiences.

Sitting at the heart of the marketing operation, you'll help ensure the right projects are being delivered at the right time, bringing structure, coordination and commercial focus to an ambitious marketing agenda.

The role
As Marketing Planner, you'll act as the bridge between the wider business and marketing specialists, translating commercial priorities into clear, actionable marketing plans.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across a variety of functions to coordinate activity, manage priorities and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively. This is a highly visible role that combines planning, project management, stakeholder engagement and performance tracking.

Key areas of focus
- Develop and maintain integrated marketing plans that support business objectives.
- Translate commercial priorities into clear marketing briefs and delivery plans.
- Coordinate activity across multiple marketing disciplines and specialist teams.
- Manage planning schedules, workflows and key project milestones.
- Support campaign planning, prioritisation and resource allocation.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.
- Monitor delivery against plans and provide regular progress updates.
- Identify risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Support performance reporting and campaign review processes.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of planning frameworks and ways of working.

About you
You'll be a highly organised marketing professional who thrives on bringing people, projects and priorities together. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, you'll have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to keep multiple workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

We're looking for someone who combines commercial awareness with strong planning discipline, enjoys working collaboratively and can confidently influence across different teams and levels of the business.

You may have experience in marketing planning, campaign management, marketing operations, project management or a similar coordination-focused role where you've been responsible for driving activity from concept through to delivery.

- Processing Expense and Credit Card claims - checking for VAT compliance and GL coding.
- Updating various spreadsheets including; Pre-Payments, Fixed Assets, Invoices log, where applicable identified during the processing of the Invoices and Expenses.
- Assisting with the payment runs, checking that the Invoices have been authorised and highlighting them for payment.
- Processing manual payments for monies due to suppliers based overseas. Sending remittances to the supplier.
- Assisting with incoming calls from suppliers chasing payments.
- Supplier Statement reconciliations.
- Daily Sales invoicing - checking and matching system generated invoices against the Customer Orders prior to submission to ensure any errors are identified and resolved i.e., checking Purchase Order Numbers, pricing etc.
- Responsible for sending Customer Statements monthly and actioning any queries such as copy invoices, logging and resolving invoices in dispute, sending POD's.
- Cash allocation daily against remittances received.
- Ad hoc Credit Control - communicating with Customers via email and via telephone to chase overdue accounts assigned by the Accounts Manager. Logging and resolving any issues that are identified, working with other departments. Escalating problem accounts to the Office Manager.
- Supporting the finance team with ad hoc duties

What you will need to succeed:
- Part-qualified AAT or qualified, or qualified by experience
- Knowledge of transactional finance and the month-end process
- Experience of using Excel for reporting is a must
- Experience of using a large ERP system
- Excellent communication skills and investigative by nature
